entry.title: Odin 2 1.4.9
entry.summary: # Odin 2 v1.4.9 ## What's new - **Mono output option:** in Logic (and other hosts) the plugin can also go on a mono instrument track; the sound is the stereo sound folded to one channel. - **MPC OS 3.10.1:** the plugin folder carries a `plugin.json`, so it can be copied straight into `VST2 Plugins`, and an Akai SDK-format zip (`-mpc-sdk.zip`, one folder for every MPC) comes with the release. - **Desktop VST3 for MPC Desktop and DAWs:** `Odin-2-1.4.9-macos-vst3.zip` (one file for Apple Silicon an

entry.title: Odin 2 1.4.8
entry.summary: ## Fixes - **Lower CPU on Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live 3 and other 64-bit models).** The Gen2 build didn't switch on the processor's fast handling of tiny numbers while Odin renders, so filter and effect tails fading towards silence ran much slower than they should: in measurements a released chord's tail cost about 5 times as much on average (up to 28 times), and held notes about 8 % more. entry.title: Odin 2 1.4.7
entry.summary: Odin 2, TheWaveWarden's synthesizer, on MPC OS - Odin's own engine, 261 factory patches, voices sized to the MPC. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force. Installing plugins this way is unofficial: back up first

entry.title: Odin 2 1.4.3
entry.summary: Catalog metadata and packaging update. This release repackages the existing 1.4.1 plugin payload with corrected 1.4.3 version and catalog metadata, preserving the earlier bank and patch navigation UI assets. It is not a newly compiled plugin binary. Architecture: ARMv7 Catalog ID: odin2 License: GPL-3.0-only MPC OS compatibility: 3.x
